run_vr_minitaur: run the pybullet script that tracks a quadruped robot with a VR controller in real time
connect_pybullet_vr: connect to pybullet using shared memory for VR or fall back to the GUI client
load_urdf_robot: load a quadruped minitaur URDF model into the pybullet simulation environment
create_vr_constraint: create a fixed joint constraint that attaches the robot to a VR controller position and orientation
change_vr_constraint: change an existing constraint to update the robot position and orientation from VR controller events
